Company description
Inter IKEA Systems BV is the global franchise owner of the IKEA Concept. As the driving force behind the development and continuous evolution of the IKEA brand, our mission is to create a better everyday life for the many people.
We offer an open working environment where everyone feels comfortable to experiment, try new ways and dare to ask: “What if…?” And we offer possibilities for you to develop yourself and your career globally. Read more about us at here .
We are currently looking for an intern to join our technology management team and contribute to understanding how emerging technologies and AI are shaping the future of business, technology, and competence development within IKEA.
This is a unique opportunity to work closely with senior technology leadership and gain insight into how strategic technology decisions are made in a global organization. You will have the chance to bring fresh perspectives, challenge assumptions, and help us better understand how the next generation is adopting and working with technology and AI. If you are an excellent critical thinker, comfortable with exploring ideas, and want to gain experience in a challenging and fast-paced environment, this is the opportunity for you.
Job description
As a Tech & Platform intern in Inter IKEA Systems BV, you will:
Work closely with leaders across technology, architecture and security to contribute to discussion around the future direction of technology.
Contribute to the day-to-day management and transformation agenda, supporting planning, coordination, follow-up and other initiatives while gradually taking ownership of assignments.
Explore trends and developments in AI and emerging technology trends, bringing outside-in and next-generation perspective.
Explore how AI and new technologies are transforming ways of working, learning, and developing competencies across organizations.
Investigate how AI is changing the way people learn, work and develop competence, and what this could mean for IKEA.
Translate findings into clear recommendations, presentations, and discussion materials for senior leaders.
Bring new perspectives and ideas to leadership discussions and contribute to strategic thinking around technology and talent.
Work independently on your internship assignment while collaborating with technology leaders, architects, and security professionals across the organization.
Most importantly, we offer our interns the opportunity to influence the agenda they work on. You will have ownership of your assignments and be encouraged to shape your internship journey based on your interests, curiosity, and ideas.
Qualification
To be successful as our Tech & Platform intern, you must:
Have a strong interest in emerging technologies, digital transformation, and AI.
Be curious about how technology influences organizations, leadership, and the future of work.
Be studying towards a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in artificial intelligence, data science, computer science, engineering, information management, technology management, or a related field.
Be proactive, independent, energetic, and comfortable taking initiative.
Have excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills.
Be confident communicating your ideas and perspectives to different stakeholders.
Be comfortable experimenting with different ideas and challenging the existing way of thinking.
Have excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Are available for a full-time internship for 5 to 6 months and based in the Netherlands.
At IKEA, we are looking for diverse and competent people to joins us. We believe that people that bring different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.
If you have any special needs that require any accommodations in the recruitment process, please let us know.
What we offer
A very unique opportunity to work closely with the Technology & Platform management team and gain insights into strategic leadership and decision making.
Room to influence, bring your own ideas, challenge our thinking and take ownership of assignments.
The possibility to develop your skills both on a personal and professional level.
An international and collaborative environment, with opportunity to join selected activities including travel.
An internship allowance, and travel allowance if you don’t have a student travel card.
More Information
Additional Information
This internship is full time (36-40 hours per week) and based in Delft, the Netherlands. Our offices are in the same building as the IKEA Delft Store. We would like you to start 1 February 2027, preferably mid-January.
*note: we do not offer relocation support for this role.
If we sparked your interest and you see yourself being our Tech & Platform Intern, send us your CV and motivation (in English) explaining why you are the best match for this internship. Applications without a motivational letter will not be considered.
The closing date to apply for this position is December 10, 2026 . We’ll start inviting candidates right away, so don’t wait too long to apply. This job ad may close earlier if we find our next intern before then!
We look forward to hearing from you!
